City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 9, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.

2.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS

Presentation by Associate Planner Plagemann on the Permit Ready Accessory Dwelling Unit (PRADU) Program
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 14, 2018 Regular Meeting, November 28, 2018 Regular Meeting, December 11, 2018 Special Meeting, December 12, 2018 Special Meeting, and December 12, 2018 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-01-09 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-01-09 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Consideration of Proposed Changes to the calendar year 2019 City Council Meeting Schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the proposed changes to the calendar year 2019 City Council Meeting Schedule and adopt City Council Resolution 2019-01 Approving the 2019 meeting schedule.
2019-01-09 Item 08C Council Meeting Schedule
REVISED Attachment 1 & Exhibit A to Resolution - 2019 Regular Meeting Schedule (added 1/7/19)
8D.
As-needed website development and customizations contract. Contact Person: IT Supervisor Van Pelt
1) Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a professional services contract, in substantial form, and any necessary amendments with 13Below for a term of one-year with the option to extend two additional one-year periods, for a total not to exceed amount of $45,000 for as-needed website development and customizations; and 2) Authorize the IT Department Manager to execute any necessary task orders associated with the fully executed as-needed website development and customizations contract with 13Below within the granted authority.
2019-01-09 Item 08D As Needed IT Professional Services for Website Customizations
8E.
Amendment 12 to the Agreement with Tyler Technologies, Inc. for the purchase of Planned Annual Continuing Education (PACE) Training. Contact Person: IT Supervisor Van Pelt
1) Approve Amendment 12, in substantial form, in consultation with the City Attorney, and authorize the City Manager, to enter into the amended agreement with Tyler Technologies, Inc. for annual PACE training beginning in FY 2018-19 in the amount of $7,700.
2019-01-09 Item 08E Tyler Contract Amendment PACE
8F.
Authorize Bluebeam electronic plan review annual software maintenance. Contact Person: IT Supervisor Van Pelt
1) Authorize Bluebeam annual software maintenance in an amount of $28,320 in FY 2018-19, and authorize anticipated Bluebeam annual software maintenance renewals in amounts of $31,152 in FY 2019-20 and $34,267 in FY 2020-21.
2019-01-09 Item 08F Bluebeam ASM
8G.
Construction agreement for I-Net Fiber Build-Out between City Hall and Fire Station 1. Contact Person: IT Supervisor Contreras
1) Award contract to DBX, Inc. in the amount of $46,125; 2) Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a construction agreement with DBX, Inc., in substantial form, in the amount of $46,125 plus 10 percent contingency for a total project not to exceed amount of $50,738 for the I-Net Fiber Build-Out between City Hall and Fire Station 1; and 3) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-02 amending the FY 2018-19 budget to appropriate the Governmental /Educational Access (213) budget by $3,086.
2019-01-09 Item 08G iNet Fire 1 Fiber Construction Award
8H.
Proposed procedures for investigating complaints by, against and between City Council members, Commissioners and other officials. Contact Person: Director of Human Resources Bokosky
Staff recommends that City Council approve Resolution No. 2019-06 titled - “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Establishing Procedures for Investigating Complaints By, Against, and Between City Council Members, Commissioners, and Other Elected and Appointed Officials.”
2019-01-09 Item 08H Discrimination, Harassment and Retaliation Policy
8I.
Approval of Plans and Specifications for the Bonita Drive Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS19C). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Widelski
1) Approve the plans and specifications; and 2) Authorize solicitation of construction bids.
2019-01-09 Item 08I Bonita Drive Sidewalk Design
8J.
Approval of Plans and Specifications for Sidewalk Improvements on the north side of B Street from North Coast Highway 101 to Moonlight Beach (CS18G). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Milligan
1) Approve the project plans and specifications; and 2) Authorize solicitation of construction bids.

8K.

8L.
Capital Project and Grants Update - Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Receive the report on the status of Capital Improvement and Traffic Engineering projects and grants.
2019-01-09 Item 08L Mobility Projects and Grants Update
8M.
Contract for As-Needed Architectural Services. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Authorize the City Manager, or the Manager’s designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract substantially as to form and any necessary amendments, task orders, and time extensions, with Jeff Katz Architecture in an amount not to exceed $400,000.
2019-01-09 Item 08M As Needed Architectural Services Contract for Facilities
8N.
Services for North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project (CS04D). Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
That City Council: 1) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the following: a) Agreement in the amount of $60,000 with GHD to perform a third-party peer review of the Streetscape roundabouts proposed at El Portal, Jupiter St., Grandview St., and Bishop's Gate; b) Amendment to the existing agreement with Michael Baker International (MBI) in the amount of $40,000 for overtime and additional resources to expedite the completion of final biddable construction drawings for construction beginning after Labor Day, 2019, in advance of the current schedule for construction beginning in November, 2019; c) Amendment to the existing agreement with MBI in the amount of an additional $70,000 for pre-construction potholing and utility location; d) Amendment to the existing agreement with MBI in the amount of an additional $9,000 for redesign of the Grandview roundabout intersection; e) Amendment to the existing agreement with MBI of an additional $16,000 for survey and redesign of three single-loaded parking pods on the east side of North Coast Highway 101, in NCTD right-of-way; f) Amendment to the existing agreement with MBI for an amount not to exceed $14,000 for property owner exhibits, design revisions, and presentation drawings; g) Agreement with KTU+A for $6,000 to generate high-quality visual photo simulations of two key vantage points in the Streetscape corridor, to be used for outreach and planning purposes; and h) A 10% contingency on all work up to $21,500, for a grand total of $235,500 to complete the tasks above.
2019-01-09 Item 08N Streetscape Additional Scope

Solar Program Development Agreement. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute a Program Development Agreement between the City of Encinitas and ENGIE Services U.S., in substantial form, subject to review and final approval of the City Attorney, to provide an integrated energy assessment and to identify energy conservation and renewable energy options for City facilities to bring the City’s energy demand to net zero.
2019-01-09 Item 10C Solar Program Devleopment Agreement
10D.Di
scussion of North Coast Highway 101 interim measures, improvements and funding appropriations. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
1) Council to review options and provide direction to staff; 2) Council to consider additional interim improvements and appropriation of related funds. If Council elects to implement any additional interim measures described in this report and listed below that require funding, the City Council may adopt Resolution No. 2019-08 entitled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2017-18 Adopted Budget" authorizing an additional appropriation of $____ (amount to be determined by Council Action) to fund interim improvements on N. Coast Highway 101. Additional interim improvements to consider include: 1) Two additional at grade crosswalks with rapid flashing beacons at El Portal Street and Grandview Street - $100,000 total; 2) Raised Crosswalks - $220,000 for four crosswalks ($120,000 to raise all 4); and 3) Interim 5-foot Striped Bike Lane - $1.55 million (water blast striping) or $1.8 million (slurry seal).
2019-01-09 Item 10D Interim North Coast Highway 101 Improvements

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
